resources.string: A libxposed API 102 USB management module that hooks system_server to show a USB mode and ADB chooser when connecting to a computer.
• Shows a USB chooser when connected to a computer
• Available modes: Charge only / File transfer (MTP) / Photo transfer (PTP) / USB tethering (RNDIS) / MIDI
• Enables USB debugging (ADB) with a single tap
• Lets Android handle OTG devices natively when the phone acts as USB host, without showing a chooser
• Turns ADB off after unplug (can be disabled)
• Writes logs directly to LSPosed; open LSPosed Manager to view them
1. Enable this module in LSPosed, tick \"system\" in scope, then reboot the phone
2. Check the \"Module active\" status at the top to confirm the hook is working
3. Connect to a computer with a USB cable; the USB chooser will appear
4. Choose the USB mode and ADB toggle, then tap \"OK\" to apply
5. Tap \"Re-check\" on the top status card to re-check module activation
6. Tap \"How to get logs\" to learn how to view the complete hook log in LSPosed

How to activate this module in LSPosed

1. Open LSPosed Manager (or its entry in Magisk)

2. Go to the Modules page, find "USB Manager", and open its details

3. Turn on the enable switch in the top-right corner

4. Under Scope, tick "system" (the system_server-specific scope)

5. Go back and choose Reboot, or run:
 adb shell killall system_server

After rebooting, return here and tap "Re-check" — "Module active" means success.

If it still doesn't work, check the module log in LSPosed Manager.

1. Open LSPosed Manager
2. Go to the Logs page
3. Tap the search box at the top and enter "USBManager"
4. You can now view the complete hook log, including:
 • Whether the module was injected into system_server
 • Each USB plug/unplug event
 • Whether APPLY_USB_CONFIG was received after your choice
 • Whether the mode switch and ADB toggle succeeded

[Alternative: command line]
 adb logcat -c && adb logcat -s USBManager:V LSPosedFramework:V
